Renovations in Gloucester

We carry out part and full renovations across Gloucester and Gloucestershire. A small renovation is typically finished in 5 to 7 weeks and a larger one in 7 to 10 weeks.

Call 07592 487841 WhatsApp Us

How We Do It

Every renovation is planned out and confirmed with you before work starts, and finished to a very high standard.

How Long It Takes

  • Small scale renovation: typically 5 to 7 weeks
  • Larger renovation: typically 7 to 10 weeks

A Period Building Fitted Out as Offices

The photo at the top and the first three in the gallery come from one renovation: a period building with tall sash windows and ornate plaster ceilings, fitted out with oak flooring throughout, a boardroom, a waiting area with an arched alcove and a reception desk under pendant lights.

Oak and Glass Staircases, Shelving and Media Walls

Other renovation work in our photos includes oak staircases with glass panels, an oak and glass balustrade round a landing, built in shelving with a media wall, and an arched alcove cupboard.

Photos From Our Jobs

Useful to Tell Us About a Renovation

  • Which rooms, or whether it is the whole house
  • Whether the house is lived in while the work goes on
  • Whether it needs other trades too: tiling, painting, electrics or plumbing
